title: Survivor 50 and AU Survivor: Redemption data added
summary: Full gameplay data for Survivor 50: In the Hands of the Fans and Australian Survivor: Redemption is now live! Tribal councils, challenges, placements, and advantages will all be reflected in grid eligibility. New categories also include Found and Received categories for the Billie Eilish Boomerang Idol, plus updated tribe colors for both seasons.
author: Castaway Cross

title: Full rarity percentages on the results screen
summary: The results screen now gives you the option to view eligible players alphabetically or by percentage of players who picked each castaway for each cell, so you can see exactly how common or rare each of your answers was relative to the field.
author: Castaway Cross

title: Castaway headshots added
summary: Castaway headshots are now displayed on completed result cells, so you can put a face to the name after each guess.
author: Castaway Cross

title: Rarity scores added
summary: Each correct answer shows a rarity score based on the percentage of players who chose that castaway for that cell. Chase the crowd for a high score, or go low with deep cuts from Survivor history!
author: Castaway Cross

title: Updates section + RSS feed launched
summary: Added a new updates section and a public RSS feed so players can follow changes to the site.
author: Castaway Cross

title: Results screen updates
summary: Improved the results screen by adding country flags next to each castaway's name and linking US contestants to their respective pages on Survivor-Reference.
author: Castaway Cross

title: New categories added
summary:
Added the following new categories for daily, random, and custom puzzles:
- One-Time Player
- No Tribals Before Merge
- Played as a Teen
- Played in Their 20s/30s/40s/50s/60s
author: Castaway Cross
